describe: Look inside the file to see what it is.
Only when the video is not HEVC and the video bitrate is above 10 megabits per second: Encode the video as HEVC at quality 2 of 5 (lower saves more space).
Put everything into a MKV file.
Keep only the audio tracks in English or German; if none match, keep all.
Remove all subtitles. Text subtitles are first saved as separate .srt files.
Name the result "{name}.shrunk" (where {name} is the original name).
Keep the original when the new file is not smaller.
Play 3 minute(s) from the middle of the finished file before anything is replaced; if it does not play cleanly, the job fails.
Move the finished file into /data/shrunk/, keeping its folder layout.

easy_default_describe: Look inside the file to see what it is.
Only when the video is not HEVC: Encode the video as HEVC at quality 3 of 5 (lower saves more space).
Put everything into a MKV file.
Keep every audio track exactly as it is.
